aboutText: Brittany Hunter is an aspiring retiree and local Big Bear artist. She dabbles in wood burning, acrylics, and pastels. Brittany is a Jersey transplant and believes Bigfoot is closer than you think and Halloween should be year round.
contactText: Custom orders, commissions, prints, and other questions.
heroDescription: Art by B Hunter, across woodburning, acrylic painting, pastels, mixed media, illustration, and more.
